description: Post-AR tranche. 27 commits: discriminator split (meta_idx), payload activation (14 layouts across JSON+CSS L4), clone reduction (egraph 11→5), CSS escape classifier, tape capacity /2+2, FAMILY_HELPER policy move, host.rs 607→423 LOC, SIMD fractional scan (NEON+SSE4.2), KvPair tape kind. Bootstrap regen coherence issue deferred (host.rs peel_wrappers changes IR enough to break regen parser). JSON/CSS bench regression pre-dates AR (AQ.5/AQ.6 era).

payload_layouts.note: JSON: null→U8, bool→Bool, number→F64. CSS L4: 11 dimension/keyword rules.

json_monolithic.note: BLOCKED: pre-existing parse failure at offset 1 on all JSON datasets. Regression from AQ.5/AQ.6 era codegen changes — dispatch table or Alt branch ordering no longer routes '{' to the object branch. Not an AR regression.

css_l4.note: BLOCKED: same codegen regression affects CSS bench entry points.
